fields.Name: T127 - AI Configuration Card Expansion
fields.Description: Exercises system-configuration's inline card expansion (toggleExpanded) that lazily reveals nested params + linked prompts for a config - richer nested content than a plain grid row, and a different component than agents/prompts/models.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the AI application using the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT the Ctrl+K search box), then open the Configuration section. In grid view, click a configuration card's header to expand it inline. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment - wait, don't navigate away. Success is that the card expands to reveal nested detail for that configuration - its Configuration Parameters and/or associated Prompts sections - and clicking again collapses it. If there are no configurations, a valid empty state counts.

judgeValidationCriteria: Configuration cards are listed (or a valid empty state is shown)
Clicking a card header expands it inline to reveal nested content (Configuration Parameters and/or associated Prompts), and it collapses on a second click
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
